title: 宝塚記念の後に・父から子へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross wins the Takarazuka Kinen. Miraculously, as if in response to her fantastic performance, her father recovers too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She doesn't need to worry about her family anymore. Having inherited her father's lightning, Tamamo Cross heads for the autumn Tenno Sho as the second-generation Lightning.
